title: Copy the span, describe the queue (21 Oct 2026)
summary: Amazon's hybrid tagging-plus-generation decoder for attribute extraction on a 0.6B model, LY Corporation's in-house encoders against a frontier LLM at a fraction of the cost, GitHub's ModernBERT secret classifier replacing an LLM pipeline, a trial of a fine-tuned 0.8B ticket router against Claude when new queues arrive, and BanglaShield's compact safety classifier across scripts.
